name: wgb-strapi
description: Strapi CMS for the WeddingGiftBox blog
_overridesNote: Pinning @strapi/strapi is not enough to pin Strapi.
Its own packages depend on each other through caret ranges, so a fresh
install resolves them to whatever is latest that day. That split this
install across two minor versions — core, content-manager and the plugins
at 5.43.0, but @strapi/admin, utils, permissions and four others at
5.55.1 — which loads two copies of the admin's RTK Query API. The visible
symptom is a Content Manager that spins forever on 'Loading content.'
with every request answering 200, and one console warning:
'mismatch between slice and middleware for the reducerPath adminApi'.
These overrides hold the whole family at one version. Remove them only
together with a deliberate upgrade of @strapi/strapi itself.
